purpose: Phase 1 cross-site comparison. One row per reference site, drawn only from the per-site JSONs in this directory. Every value is measured from fetched markup, fetched CSS or Chromium computed styles, or it is null with a stated reason. Nothing is estimated.

viewport.desktop: 1440x900 (atlasobscura measured at 379x821 on mobile because the tab would not hold 375x812)

method: Values were read out of data/design-study/<site>.json, which record the fetch and browser passes. No new fetch was made to build this file.

columnDefinitions.fontStackShort: Body face plus any distinct display or interface face, from computed font-family on the measured page.
columnDefinitions.body: Computed font-size and line-height on the measured prose paragraph. staticCandidate* is filled only when the measured value is null.
columnDefinitions.charactersPerLine: Paragraph content width divided by measured average glyph width. The commonly cited comfortable range is 45-75.
columnDefinitions.h1BodyRatio: Computed h1 font-size divided by computed body font-size on the same page.
columnDefinitions.baseSpacingUnit: Largest unit that divides the majority of margin/padding/gap declarations, weighted by occurrence.
columnDefinitions.breakpointsPx: Width thresholds from @media rules; em/rem converted at the declared 16px root. loadBearing = thresholds carrying the layout by rule count.
columnDefinitions.readingColumnWidthPx: Rendered width of the prose paragraph, not of its wrapper.
columnDefinitions.navPattern: persistent = site navigation is visible without an action; on-demand = it must be opened. Classified from computed position, rendered height and the presence of an opener control.
columnDefinitions.darkModeMechanism: How a dark palette is selected: prefers-color-scheme, class/attribute, or none.
columnDefinitions.bodyContrastRatio: WCAG contrast of computed body text colour against the first ancestor that paints a background.
columnDefinitions.textToHtmlRatio: innerText length divided by outerHTML length on the measured page.
columnDefinitions.flag: measured = every column in the row came from markup, CSS or computed style. measured (partial) = all columns here are measured, but a named field elsewhere in the site JSON is unknown. blocked = nothing was measured.

blocked.reason:
HTTP 403 Cloudflare JavaScript/cookie challenge on every request. The static fetch (two attempts, second with full sec-ch-ua and Sec-Fetch-* headers) and the Chromium browser pass both received the same 5.7-6.0 KB interstitial: document.title 'Just a moment...', one

, 58-264 characters of body text, and no Wikiwand markup. The app shell was never served, so there are no stylesheet URLs to resolve and no computed styles to read. Solving the bot check was out of scope and not attempted.
blocked.consequence: Every typography, spacing, colour, layout and navigation field for this site is null. Wikiwand's reading-page tokens are unmeasured, not estimated. Getting them needs an approach that clears the challenge as a normal browser session would.
